question.value: What are the molecular gas properties (temperature, density, mass, alpha_CO) of the lensed merger H1429-0028, using new APEX CO(3-2) and CO(6-5) data plus earlier ALMA lines?

claims.hypothesis: What are the NS gas conditions and mass?
claims.experiment: LVG analysis of CO J=2-6 and [CI]
claims.result: T~70 K, log n~3.7, MH2=4e9 Msun

evidence.quote: These parameters are estimated to be T$\sim$70 K, $\log({\rm n [cm^{-3}]})\sim3.7$, and $dv\sim10$ km/s/pc.
